gates.requiredScope: Fleet freshness, arbitrary default-branch resolution, safe pull classification, complete inventory, bounded network evidence and downstream mutation refusal.
Owned worktree leases, normal cleanup, hard-abort recovery, PID-reuse protection, exact cleanup authorization and idempotence.
Semantically equivalent Bash and PowerShell behavior, Windows/Linux regression protection, parser, analyzer and platform execution.
Dynamic profile-catalog cardinality plus non-mutating MSL and non-MSL registry consistency decisions.
Bilingual CEFR-B2 text-first documentation, manpage and help consistency, homogeneity, secret scan, statistics rendering and clean diffs.
Maintenance performs no commit, push, pull-request creation or merge in target repositories and preserves unrelated checkout state.
All mandatory provider checks and provider-neutral acceptance evidence correspond to the exact pull-request head reviewed before merge.
DocFX/web accessibility, cloud architecture and release supply-chain evidence.
gates.rationale: Feature 017 changes local maintenance scripts and their text documentation, not public web navigation, cloud services, dependencies, packages or a product release.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Reevaluate if API/docs navigation, web output, cloud boundaries, dependencies, packages or release provenance enter the actual diff.
